convert_audio_channels: convert a multi-channel audio tensor to mono by downmixing all channels
convert_audio_samplerate: convert audio from one samplerate to another while adjusting channel count
create_lowpass_filter_bank: create a bank of low pass filters with specified cutoff frequencies for audio
compute_mel_frequencies: compute evenly spaced mel frequencies between a minimum and maximum Hz range
convert_hz_to_mel: convert a frequency in hertz to its equivalent value on the mel scale
